entries.round: task:Implement Task 4.3: Rate Limiter. 1. Create a new file 'rate_limiter.py'. 2. Define a class 'RateLimiter' using a token bucket algorithm (thread-safe). 3. It should support different limits per backend (e.g. 10 RPM for Claude, 15 RPM for Gemini). 4. Integrate this into Agent.call_llm in agents.py to wait if the limit is hit. IMPORTANT: Wrap the code in <write_file path="rate_limiter.py"> tags and wrap the modified agents.py in <write_file path="agents.py"> tags.
